peoples_entry.note: Copper-and-tin Highland Nine-Clan confederacy around Ardent & Upper Cut (LORE.md S6.4): Norse-Gaelic / Swiss-Alpine / Early-Modern Scottish Highland synthesis of stave-halls, Clanthing moots, galloglass huscarls, and MC-06 Ardent Bronze-Gunner culverin foundries (10 tiers at 100% M+F parity; tools/garments/cultures/free_clans.py).
